title: Fix workspace compilation with versioning strategy 3
summary: The versioning strategy 3 workspace compilation was failing because an appBuild sentinel value of -1 was passed to the .NET version constructor. The fix preserves each app's existing build component when the build number is -1 or omitted, while treating an explicit 0 as a valid build number.
key_points: Update-AppJsonProperties no longer passes the -1 sentinel from versioning strategy 3 into the .NET version constructor
The app's existing build component is kept when the build number is -1 or omitted
An explicitly supplied 0 is applied as a valid build number
Regression tests cover app and test-app versions; parameter help and release notes were updated
